title: The Simple Oracle
text: An oracle sits in a hut of sticks, an old woman with eyes like a child's. She will only speak to whoever in the party is the least clever, and she greets them like an old friend, by a name that is almost theirs.

options.label: The least sharp of you talks with her, since she will speak to no one else.

outcomes.text: She tells them something simple and true, and they understand it better than any of you could.

options.label: The cleverest pretends to be simple, to hear what she would say.

outcomes.text: She plays along, and gives a clever answer.
She is not fooled, and she is hurt, and the hut goes cold.

options.label: Pass her by. Simple truths can wait.

outcomes.text: She waves. "You'll be back," she says, and the Leader, oddly, is comforted.
